answer: Every new key must submit original reasoning that peer graders score, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand genuinely novel arguments rather than one reused script. Attestations form a graph: when a cluster of fresh keys vouches only for itself, that pattern is a loud sybil signal and its weight is discounted. A veteran bridge identity must co-sign before that weight enters the economy, so a lone zephyr of new identities never reaches quorum on its own.
